headline: Major Saudi Oil Pipeline Shut Down After Attack – Saudi Arabia Remains Under Pressure
summary: A major Saudi oil pipeline has been shut down after an attack, as escalating Middle East conflict raises concerns about a possible global energy crisis. Effects are reaching German fuel pumps.
why: Saudi Arabia is one of the world's largest crude exporters, so pipeline disruptions can tighten global oil supply and feed through to fuel prices.
why_moved: The pipeline shutdown reduces crude supply during a period of Middle East tension, which typically lifts oil prices.
